# Juan Falibene - Music Selector & DJ

Juan Falibene is a Disc Jockey and music selector based in Barcelona, Spain, specializing in Soul, Funk, Modern Soul, Rare Groove, Jazz, Disco, and House.

## Biography & Career Highlights
- **Active DJ & Selector**: Performing and selecting music since 2016.
- **Residency at Café Berlin (Madrid)**: Held a residency from 2016 to 2019, sharing the stage with international artists such as Folamour, Hugo LX, Nickodemus, Pabels, and Manu Desrets.
- **Radio Collaborations**: Worked with radio stations in Madrid, Barcelona, Glasgow, and London.
- **Current Base**: Barcelona, Spain (open to listening sessions, club DJ bookings, and creative collaborations).

## Key Content & Portfolio Sections
- **Radio**: Broadcast appearances and recorded radio shows.
- **Mixes**: Live recordings and curated sets showcasing organic sounds, disco, and house textures.
- **Playlists**: Regularly updated Spotify playlist selections featuring new musical discoveries.
- **Discava!**: A custom-built music discovery web app (accessible at https://dev.juanfalibene.com/discava/index.html).
- **Presskit**: Complete media resources, bio, and promoter materials (available at https://music.juanfalibene.com/presskit).
